newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.13 up at 40.85 to the dollar in the kerb market on Sunday as supply of the dollar rose while trading was dull, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to fall at open on Monday as the current levels of dollar would attract major investors.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 10.20 percent compared to 10.50 percent on the last closing on Thursday. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
